cellObject.description: Cell value object. Must have "type" ("static" or "linkedRows") and "value".

type.description: "static" for text/number/bool/select, "linkedRows" for linked record fields

value.description: The field value. String/number/boolean for static. Array of {foreignRowId, foreignRowDisplayName} for linkedRows.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

name: set_record_template_cell
